purpose: parameters for costs/futures_impact.py:FuturesSqrtImpact: mean daily volume V_d and session volatility sigma_d
formula: I = Y * sigma_d * sqrt(|Q_rem| / V_d) * P * sign(Q_rem)   (price units)
coefficient_Y_note: fixed, not fitted: inside the 0.5-1 range reported for stocks and futures in Tóth, Eisler and Bouchaud (2016), "The square-root impact law also holds for option markets", arXiv:1602.03043
why_default: day1m_2016_2023 is measured on 2016-2023 one-minute front-contract bars. trades_2025_2026 and hourly_2010_2026 extend to 2026-09; a study on earlier years that uses one applies a recent measurement to a past window.

lines.trades_2025_2026: ADV in contracts and a session sigma in dollars per full contract, 9 roots, 2025-09-11..2026-09-10, from Databento CME trades; price level from the last hourly bar
lines.hourly_2010_2026: day-session sigma and notional, 36 roots, from hourly front-contract bars. No volume: the line carries no adv_contracts and cannot build a brick
lines.day1m_2016_2023: ADV and sigma computed from one-minute front-contract bars over front-contract sessions 2016-01-04..2023-12-29, 36 roots

why_multiplier_disagreements: Empty: every root's multiplier agrees across the spec files. The cent- and percent-quoted roots ZC, ZS, ZW, ZL, LE, HE and SR3 are read through tick_usd_full_contract, and tests/unit/test_futures_impact.py pins their usd_per_point values.
